<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#192735">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="證券法規與實務">
<title>證券法規與實務｜私人題庫</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f6f8;--paper:#fff;--ink:#192735;--muted:#647484;--line:#e1e7ed;--accent:#14675f;--bad:#b72c39}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans TC","PingFang TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}
.wrap{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px}
.card{width:min(460px,100%);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 16px 50px #12273b12}
.icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--ink);color:white;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-size:26px;margin:0 0 8px}p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 22px;font-size:14px}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}
input{width:100%;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;font-size:16px;outline:none}
input:focus{border-color:#78aaa4;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #14675f18}
button{width:100%;margin-top:12px;padding:13px 16px;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.err{min-height:22px;color:var(--bad);font-size:12px;margin-top:10px}
.foot{font-size:11px;color:#82909b;margin-top:18px;line-height:1.7}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap"><main class="card">
  <div class="icon">證</div>
  <h1>證券法規與實務私人題庫</h1>
  <p>此題庫內容已加密。請輸入密碼後，在這台裝置上解密開啟；密碼不會傳送到伺服器。</p>
  <form id="login">
    <label for="pw">密碼</label>
    <input id="pw" type="password" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="輸入密碼" autofocus>
    <button type="submit">開啟題庫</button>
    <div class="err" id="err"></div>
  </form>
  <div class="foot">建議在 iPad Safari 開啟後，點「分享」→「加入主畫面」。同一個開啟階段重新整理時可自動解鎖；完全關閉後會再次要求密碼。</div>
</main></div>
